saw_lines: Buyers of bitter drops and gut supplements pick one ailment, try one bottle, then reorder only if it fits their routine.
So the sale is won in the first line of the ad, where a buyer decides whether the complaint is theirs.
Your 13 of 28 copy ads open on one weight loss story. Test three new openers built on the hormone check, the 9 g fiber complex and the morning shot.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 1 Nov 2026
points: 13 of your 28 copy ads open on the same weight loss story, so they all chase one buyer. Test three new openers against it, built on the hormone check, the 9 g fiber gut complex, and the morning shot.

The same exact copy runs in 13 of your 28 ads, so repeat viewers see the same pitch again. Keep the body copy, but rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each ad so the feed stops repeating.

None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so the weight loss promise has nothing concrete behind it. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

Your median ad runs 137 words and the longest 152, so the key benefit gets buried before a reader reaches it. Cut each ad to two lines plus one clear next step, and put the product name in the first line.
